```{r}
# this file was coded with help of ChatGPT o4 mini high
library(data.table)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
data_original <- readRDS(here("Daten", "Daten_verarbeitet", "data_overweight_cens.rds"))
data_overweight_unique <- data_original %>% filter(Study_Day == 1)
dt <- as.data.table(data_overweight_unique)
```

```{r}
# Number of Patients died between 4 and 30 days (event <= 30 and PatientDied = 1)
result_died <- dt[event <= 30 & PatientDied == 1]
nrow(result_died)
nrow(result_died)/nrow(dt)
```

```{r}
# Number of Patients discharged alive between 4 and 30 days (event <= 30 and PatientDischarged = 1)
result_discharged <- dt[event <= 30 & PatientDischarged == 1]
nrow(result_discharged)
nrow(result_discharged)/nrow(dt)
```

```{r}
# Number of Patients still hospitalized after 30 days (event > 30)
result_survived <- dt[event > 30]
nrow(result_survived)
nrow(result_survived)/nrow(dt)
```

```{r}

# sanity check
1801 + 4556 + 2711 == nrow(dt)

```



```{r}

# 4) Summarise by Year
summary_by_year <- dt[, .(
  n         = .N,
  Percent   = round(.N / nrow(dt) * 100, 1),
  Mort30Day = round(mean((PatientDied == 1 & event <= 30), na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
), by = Year][order(Year)]

sum(summary_by_year$n) == nrow(dt)
sum(summary_by_year$Percent) == 100
weighted.mean(summary_by_year$Mort30Day, w = summary_by_year$n)

# Rename columns
setnames(
  summary_by_year,
  old = c("Year", "n", "Percent", "Mort30Day"),
  new = c("Jahr","n", "Prozent", "30-Tage-Krankenhausmortalität (%)")
)

# Turn your data into a table grob
tbl <- tableGrob(summary_by_year, rows = NULL)

# measure it (in inches)
table_w <- convertWidth(sum(tbl$widths),  "inches", valueOnly = TRUE)
table_h <- convertHeight(sum(tbl$heights),"inches", valueOnly = TRUE)

# Save as PNG
png(
  filename = "summary_by_year_table.png",
  width    = table_w,   # in inches
  height   = table_h,   # in inches
  units    = "in",      # interpret width/height in inches
  res      = 300        # DPI
)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(tbl)
dev.off()

# 5) View
print(summary_by_year)

```

# 2) Create a Ventilation‐day category
dt[, VentCat := fcase(
  DaysMechVent <= 1, "1 - 24h",      # 0 up through 1 day
  DaysMechVent <= 2, "25 - 48h",      # >1 up through 2 days
  DaysMechVent  > 2, "> 48 h",       # more than 2 days
  default = NA_character_
)]

```{r}
# 1) define a little helper that returns the six stats for a numeric vector
calc_stats <- function(x) {
  c(
    Minimum      = min(x,              na.rm = TRUE),
    `1. Quartil` = unname(quantile(x, 0.25,    na.rm = TRUE)),
    Median       = median(x,           na.rm = TRUE),
    Mittelwert   = mean(x,             na.rm = TRUE),
    `3. Quartil` = unname(quantile(x, 0.75,    na.rm = TRUE)),
    Maximum      = max(x,              na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# 2) apply it to your three columns; this gives a 6×3 matrix
stats_mat <- sapply(dt[, .(Age, ApacheIIScore, BMI)], calc_stats)

# 3) turn it into a data.table, with the rownames as a “Statistic” column
summary_table <- as.data.table(stats_mat, keep.rownames="Statistic")

# 4) rename the numeric columns to match your table header
setnames(summary_table,
         old = c("Statistic","Age","ApacheIIScore","BMI"),
         new = c("Statistik","Alter","ApacheIIScore","BMI"))

# Turn your data into a table grob
tbl <- tableGrob(summary_table, rows = NULL)

# measure it (in inches)
table_w <- convertWidth(sum(tbl$widths),  "inches", valueOnly = TRUE)
table_h <- convertHeight(sum(tbl$heights),"inches", valueOnly = TRUE)

# # Save as PNG
png(
  filename = "summary_table.png",
  width    = table_w,   # in inches
  height   = table_h,   # in inches
  units    = "in",      # interpret width/height in inches
  res      = 300        # DPI
)
grid.table(summary_table, rows = NULL)

# close the device
dev.off()

print(summary_table)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# 1) ensure result is a data.table & melt long
setDT(dt)
long <- melt(dt,
             measure.vars = c("Age", "ApacheIIScore", "BMI"),
             variable.name = "Variable",
             value.name    = "Value")

# 2) compute just Mean and Median for each Variable
stats_mat <- sapply(dt[, .(Age, ApacheIIScore, BMI)], function(x) {
  c(Median = median(x, na.rm=TRUE),
    Mean   = mean(x,   na.rm=TRUE))
})
stats_dt <- as.data.table(stats_mat, keep.rownames="Statistic")
stats_dt <- melt(stats_dt,
                 id.vars       = "Statistic",
                 variable.name = "Variable",
                 value.name    = "StatValue")
# keep only Mean & Median
stats_dt <- stats_dt[Statistic %in% c("Mean","Median")]

# 3) plot
ggplot(long, aes(x = Value)) +
  geom_density(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free")+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title     = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title       = element_blank()) +
  theme_bw()
```
